# Charlie Sloane

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P23](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0023), [v3 ch.Home P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 ch.Friend P2](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

Charlie Sloane is a boy characterized by his prominent, goggle eyes. His goggly appearance is particularly noticeable when seen in the moonlight.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P23](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0023), [v3 ch.Autumn P6](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0006)_

## Personality

Driven by political ambition, Charlie Sloane aims to enter politics. His primary goal is to eventually serve as a member of Parliament.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)_

## History

Charlie Sloane grew up as a respectable [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) boy, once fighting [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md) over a remark about [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and telling his mother that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) was the smartest girl in school. During a farewell party for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) before college, Charlie escorted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) home, though his presence left her regretting the choice. He later traveled with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) on the journey to [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport) to begin studies at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). While at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), Charlie joined [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and their friends on social outings, including a walk through the park and [Spofford Avenue](../codex/places.md#avenue). During his second term at college, Charlie extended an unwanted proposal of marriage to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), which she did not accept.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Relationships

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlie-sloane--gilbert-blythe.md)

Charlie and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) are longtime friends and comrades who grew up in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) together and later traveled together on the train and boat to college. While they maintain a close social circle, there is a presumed rivalry between them regarding the good graces and affections of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) occasionally uses Charlie's company to distance herself from [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) when annoyed by him, though [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) remains her preferred companion.

- presumed Rival of — rivals for the good graces of Anne Shirley (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P0](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0000)</sub>
- Comrade of — traveling together from Avonlea to college (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Farewell P0](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0000)</sub>
- Friend of — longtime friends (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Park P11](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0011)</sub>

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--charlie-sloane.md)

Charlie has long harbored romantic feelings for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), eventually proposing marriage to her, only to be rejected. They spent their youth as schoolmates in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), where Charlie occasionally escorted her home, such as after the farewell party hosted by the Young People's [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society)—an offer [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accepted out of annoyance with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), though she quickly regretted it. Despite his romantic interests, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) does not return his affections.

- Romantically involved with — proposed marriage to her and was rejected (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Autumn P25](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0025), [v3 ch.Friend P2](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0002)</sub>
